affected_party: QIF users and AI agents making evidence-backed quality decisions
actual_problem: QIF records confidence and later outcomes but cannot yet calculate whether confidence tracks observed outcomes or distinguish calculable calibration from semantic quality truth.
why_it_matters: Uncalibrated confidence can create false assurance, while raw score counts cannot explain data origin, uncertainty, or when governance is required.
why_now: v0.6.30 completed governed framework learning, and current agent-evaluation practice increasingly requires outcome-based, reproducible validity checks.
